source_findings.finding: The MAIN seed list constructs two original AX tiles and three UG tiles before state_from and engine creation. Every tile()/ug()/ax() path calls fresh_language() independently.

fresh_language reauthenticates the exact original raw input2, invokes the original membership factory through unchanged full pre/post guard, and verifies original binding. Native deadline is shared, not reset.

After seed construction, state_from separately constructs another fresh language, rebuilds every offered full original tile, checks actual original legality/union, constructs decorated packets and independently checks the whole marked state. These checks must remain.

Engine construction, actual degree proposals and fresh cover certification are separate from seed building. The same interruption-aware proposer is used for current coverage; a quiet/cached delegate would change C7 and is not proposed.

The whole MAIN transaction is itself invoked through full guard. There is no extra CodeSeal boundary per recipe/candidate in its deep direct calls. Full guards around each fresh_language factory are real, but their time is unmeasured.
MarkedSemantics construction independently rechecks the full frozen marking. private_state/rebuild_tile then invoke full base/decorated reconstruction repeatedly.

checked_marking reconstructs the original authority, full row0 projection certificates, evidence and marking definition, then rechecks authority. This is actual work, not a Source timing measurement. It is part of the current verification contract; bypassing it is not a caller-only optimization.
